title: Unit Event — Our Constellation of Song — Episode8 Shooting Stars

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need has done it at last. They've been signed by a record label! Reflecting on all of the people whose support has taken them this far, Ichika thinks of a way for the band to show their gratitude.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I was a little startled when Ichika said she wanted to sing with Miku...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Obviously, we can't have Miku appear as a hologram, but everyone should think that it's a computer singing if they only hear her voice...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Miku's supposed to be backstage with one of our phones hooked up to the sound system...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It's like she's standing right next to Ichika and singing along with her.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Not just her voice...
It's like she's actually here singing with me.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I feel like I can sing better than I ever have... With Miku, I can do anything...!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (The way Ichika and I are singing, the way they're playing their instruments... It's all resonating with the audience...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Our song is bringing us all together...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(Ichika, Saki, Shiho, Honami...
When we first met, you were all so far apart.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (You all cared deeply about one another, but didn't know how to express that feeling. As a result, you ended up hurting each other...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But you did your best to overcome all that, one step at a time. You were driven by your collective desire to be friends again.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I know your kindness and the hard work you've put in better than anyone else.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (That kindness gives you all the ability to empathize with those who've been hurt. It's why so many people feel so moved by your music.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(But you can do more...
I think you can make your message heard even louder and clearer...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (So, let's show them what it really means to be moved by a performance!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(The way Miku's singing...
I can feel her pulling us forward...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (They're all here and really enjoying the show... We're really getting through to them.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But if that's what they want, then I should also...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Everyone who's been supporting me is here. I hope they understand how grateful I am...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I want to keep singing! I don't want to stop...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She's able to sing such an inspiring song, drawing us in along with the audience...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I was starting to think I'd learned to do some of what she can... But I'm still nowhere near her...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (No, I have to try. I want to move the hearts of the masses and express my feelings the way Miku does...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (If I'm going to do that as a professional musician, I need to stop writing myself off so much...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'm going to bring everyone together by singing...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (A person who heard me sing will hopefully pay it forward and help someone else, be that through song or otherwise.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Just like how Miku moved my heart all those years ago... I'm bringing everyone this song...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (To sing like Miku. To bring everyone together...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I hope our performance today conveyed at least some portion of our gratitude to all of you out there...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We plan to keep putting on heartfelt performances like this in the future.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, from the bottom of my heart, thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, you did a remarkable job.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thank you.
It really was fun...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
At the same time, I'm sorry.
I feel bad about being the only one who got to go over.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
You gotta let me go if they decide to do something like this again!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Still, you and the girls put on such an incredible performance.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes...
At times, it was Ichika who was pulling me along as we sang.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And I could feel her determination slowly come to the surface...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It became clear that she wants to bring as many people together as she can through singing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That determination is sure to take Leo/need far.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I can't wait to see what the future has in store for them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, that was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, it was. It felt so great to share all that energy with the audience throughout our show.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. In terms of getting our message across to a crowd, this was probably our best performance yet.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, you hear that?! Shiho's giving us her seal of approval!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: My mind's just wandering a bit. I don't think I've fully realized that our show's over.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You really went above and beyond today, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Especially when you sang with Miku.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. While I was watching you during the show, Ichi, you reminded me of when we were little.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, when we first started our band!
Your eyes totally sparkled every time you sang a Miku song.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. She's right...
I remember how you barged into our classroom and exclaimed, “We should play Miku songs together!” You were so excited.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: In that sense, Miku alone didn't bring us together... You were just as instrumental, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah...
And we ended up playing together the first time we were all in SEKAI because of what you said back then.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I believe we're standing here today because of what you did all those years ago.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Ichika, you've always been that way. Ever since we were little...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This all reminds me of how whenever we got into a big argument over something...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, like the ones Shiho and I had!
Ichi would always jump in and do her best to get us to stop fighting!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, to be fair, Ichika would usually jump in without much of a plan, and Honami would come up with a compromise for us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But every time you stumbled around trying to get us to stop, Ichika, we'd end up seeing how pointless our arguments were...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
So, I agree...
You've been the glue that holds us together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, did you see that streak of light?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We can already see them this clearly...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We got to put on an amazing show...
And now we get to see shooting stars on the way home...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We should watch this show together!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go find a place with a better view.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, since we're here...
That place should actually be pretty close.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I had a feeling this park would give us the best view.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah... Hanging out, talking and seeing a meteor shower on our way home...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You said you wanted us to be together like this forever...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I also wished for this the day before I was given the okay to go back to school.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I really wanted us to see a meteor shower like this again someday.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm really glad that my wish came true...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why don't we make the same wish again? For all of us to stay together for good.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The four of us. Together. Forever and ever!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So that we get to see lots more meteor showers like this!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I also want us to stay together...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (No, I won't just wish for that...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Including us. We were given the push we needed to rekindle our friendship...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I want to do the same for Leo/need.)
